original: ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cābhīddhāttapaso'dhyajāyata | tato rātrirajāyata tataḥ samudro arṇavaḥ || samudrādarṇavādadhi saṃvatsaro ajāyata | ahorātrāṇi vidadhadviśvasya miṣato vaśī | sūryācandramasaudhātā yathāpūrvamakalpayat | divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣamatho khaḥ || ṛṣiraghamarṣaṇaḥ | anuṣṭup chandaḥ |
analyzed: ṛtam ca satyam ca abhīddhāt tapasaḥ udhi ajāyata tatas rātriḥ ajāyata tatas samudraḥ arṇavaḥ samudrāt arṇavāt adhi saṃvatsaraḥ ajāyata ahorātrāṇi vidadhat viśvasya miṣataḥ vaśī yathāpūrvam akalpayat divam ca pṛthivīm ca antarikṣam atho khaḥ ṛṣiḥ aghamarṣaṇaḥ anuṣṭubh chandaḥ

original: prajāpatirdevatā jagatsraṣṭṛtvena sūktajapasamaye dhyātavyaḥ | tapo jñānaṃ 'samyagjñānamayaṃ tapaḥ |' iti śruteḥ | tasmādabhīddhāttraṣṭavyapadārthasāṃmukhyena dīptādvartamānāt ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cājāyata | jagatsūtrabhūtaḥ prāṇaḥ satyaṃ 'prāṇo vai satyam' iti śruteḥ | ṛtamapi prāṇasvarūpameva gatimattvāt | ṛtamiti hi gatyarthasyārte rūpam |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ devatā jagat sraṣṭṛ tvena sūkta japa samaye dhyātavyaḥ tapaḥ jñānam samyak jñāna mayam tapaḥ iti śruteḥ tasmāt abhīddhāt traṣṭavya padārtha sāṃmukhyena dīptāt vartamānāt ṛtam ca satyam ca ajāyata jagat sūtra bhūtaḥ prāṇaḥ satyam prāṇaḥ vai satyam iti śruteḥ ṛtam api prāṇa svarūpam eva gatimat tvāt ṛtam iti hi gati arthasya ārte rūpam

original: mano'pi ṛtaṃ satyaṃ ca satyasaṃkapatvāt vidyudvatsuvegagāmitvācca | saṃkalpamātrāt manaḥ sahitaḥ prāṇaḥ prajāpatinā nirmita ityarthaḥ | tataḥ prāṇotpattyanantaraṃ tata eva saṃkalpamātrātprājāpatyādvātrirajāyata | añjanapuñjavarṇasāmyādrātriśabda ākāśe vartate | prāṇotpattyanantaraṃ tatra tatrākāśotpattiśrutirupaniṣatsu |
analyzed: manaḥ api ṛtam satyam ca vidyut vat su vega gāmi tvāt ca saṃkalpa mātrāt manaḥ sahitaḥ prāṇaḥ prajāpatinā nirmitaḥ iti arthaḥ tatas prāṇa utpatti anantaram tatas eva saṃkalpa mātrāt prājāpatyāt vā atriḥ ajāyata añjana puñja varṇa sāmyāt rātri śabdaḥ ākāśe vartate prāṇa utpatti anantaram tatra tatra ākāśa utpatti śrutiḥ upaniṣatsu

original: tata ākāśotpattyanantaraṃ samudro arṇavaḥ jalamarṇavarūpaṃ gatiyuktaṃ polūyamānaṃ jalaṃ jātamityarthaḥ | samudragrahaṇaṃ bhūtatrayasyānyasyāpyutpattiṃ lakṣayati | tathāca śrutiḥ 'ākāśādvāyurvāyoragniragnerāpo'dyaḥ pṛthivī' iti |

original: kramāniyamaṃ ca tatra tatra darśayannṛṣiravidyānirmitatvena bhedavivartasyādvaite kramasyāpāramārthikatāmāha - samudrādarṇavāt saṃvatsaraḥ samrāṭ 'adhirīśvare' 'yasmādadhikam' iti samuṃdraśabdātsaptamyāṃ jātāyāṃ vyatyayena pañcamī | samudragrahaṇaṃ ca bhūtapañcakopalakṣaṇam | adhibhūteṣu samrāṭ jātaḥ bhūtakhāmī bhūta ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: krama aniyamam ca tatra tatra darśayan ṛṣiḥ avidyā nirmita tvena bheda vivartasya advaite kramasya apāramārthika tām āha samudrāt arṇavāt saṃvatsaraḥ samrāj adhiḥ īśvare yasmāt adhikam iti samuṃdra śabdāt saptamyām jātāyām vyatyayena pañcamī samudra grahaṇam ca bhūta pañcaka upalakṣaṇam adhibhūteṣu samrāj jātaḥ bhūta khāmī bhūtaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kiṃ kurvāṇaḥ samrāḍajāyata | ahorātrāṇi tatparicchedakāriṇau sūryācandramasau vidadhat janayan | kathaṃ virāḍ janayati, viniyuṅkte cādityādikaṃ kāryaśeṣeṣu iti cet tatrāha yato'sau miṣato nimeṣonmeṣavato viśvasya samastabhuvanasya dhātā nirmātāto vidadhāti, tasya ca vaśītikṛtvā yathāyogyatvaṃ yuṅkte | kathaṃ vidadhat |
analyzed: kim kurvāṇaḥ samrāj ajāyata ahorātrāṇi tad pariccheda kāriṇau sūryācandramasau vidadhat janayan katham virāj janayati viniyuṅkte ca āditya ādikam kārya śeṣeṣu iti ced tatra āha yatas asau miṣataḥ nimeṣa unmeṣavataḥ viśvasya samasta bhuvanasya dhātā nirmātā atas vidadhāti tasya ca vaśīti kṛtvā yathāyogyatvam yuṅkte katham vidadhat

original: yathāpūrvaṃ pūrvakalpānatikrameṇa anādiretadīyaḥ sargapralaya ityarthaḥ | athavā yathāpūrvaṃ pūrvakarmānusāreṇa tena na muktān śarīrādinā yojayati | yadvā yathāpūrvaṃ yathākramaṃ na sarvān tulyān nirmitavān upabhogābhāvaprasaṅgāt kiṃ tarhi uccāvacān akalpayat kalpitavān |
analyzed: yathāpūrvam pūrva kalpa anatikrameṇa anādiḥ etadīyaḥ sarga pralayaḥ iti arthaḥ athavā yathāpūrvam pūrva karma anusāreṇa tena na muktān śarīra ādinā yojayati yat vā yathāpūrvam yathākramam na sarvān tulyān nirmitavān upabhoga abhāva prasaṅgāt kim tarhi uccāvacān akalpayat kalpitavān

original: athavā pṛthivīmantarikṣaṃ ca svaśca svargamiti lokatrayaṃ yathākramamakalpayaditi saṃbandhaḥ | pṛthivyā uparyantarikṣaṃ nakṣatrādilokaṃ, tataḥ pañcavidhaṃ pūrvapradarśitaṃ svargamiti | kiṃ tasya jagannirmāṇa prayojanamiti cedata āha divamiti 'divu krīḍāyām ' krīḍayetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: athavā pṛthivīm antarikṣam ca svar ca svargam iti lokatrayam yathākramam akalpayat iti saṃbandhaḥ pṛthivyāḥ upari antarikṣam nakṣatra ādi lokam tatas pañcavidham pūrva pradarśitam svargam iti kim tasya jagat nirmāṇa prayojanam iti ced atas āha divam iti krīḍāyām krīḍayā iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ 'saṃmārjanānantarabhūtamṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ cetyetayānayukta āvartayet' iti kāṭhakaśruteḥ aghamarṣaṇasūktajapaḥ kartavyaḥ | tadanantaraṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ | tathāca yājñavalkyena

analyzed: iti mārjana uttara kāle api prāṇasaṃyamaḥ coditaḥ kiṃca snāna ādau api asya upayogaḥ usti tathā ca vasiṣṭhena prāyaścitta artha tvam asya pāpa kṣaya hetu tveā uktam

original: 'āvartayetsadā yuktaḥ prāṇāyāmānpunaḥ punaḥ | ālomāgrānnakhāgrācca tapastapsyannanuttamam || prāṇāyāmāndhārayetrīnyathāśāstramatandritaḥ | ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati ||
analyzed: āvartayet sadā yuktaḥ prāṇāyāmān punar punar ā loma agrāt nakha agrāt ca tapaḥ tapsyan anuttamam prāṇāyāmān dhārayet trīn yathāśāstram atandritaḥ ahar rātra kṛtam pāpam tad kṣaṇāt eva naśyati

original: 'ahorātraṃ ca yāñjantūnhinastyajñānato dvijaḥ | tataḥ svātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmān ṣaḍācaret ||' iti | yogaśāstreṣūpaniṣatsu ca prāṇāyāmaireva pavanajaye sati bhūtendriyajayaḥ prādhānyena pratipāditaḥ | tenāsya prayatnatareṇa lakṣaṇamabhidheyam | tacca tathaiva yājñavalkyādibhiḥ pratipāditam |

original: 'gāyatrīṃ śirasā sārdhaṃ japedvyāhṛtipūrvikām | pratipraṇavasaṃyuktāṃ trirayaṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ ||

original: iti | tatra kumbhakenaiva prāṇāpānavṛtternirodhamicchanti sandhyopāsanaprāyaścittādiṣu, samādhau kumbhakena recakena ca | kumbhako bāhyavāyorācamane kriyamāṇe udarasya kumbhavatpūraṇādbhavati, recakastvāntaravāyorniḥsāraṇādudarasya riktatāpādanāt | tatrāyaṃ kramaḥ - oṃ bhūḥ
analyzed: iti tatra kumbhakena eva prāṇa apāna vṛtteḥ nirodham icchanti sandhyā upāsana prāyaścitta ādiṣu samādhau kumbhakena recakena ca kumbhakaḥ bāhya vāyoḥ ācamane kriyamāṇe udarasya kumbha vat pūraṇāt bhavati recakaḥ tu āntara vāyoḥ niḥsāraṇāt udarasya rikta tā āpādanāt tatra ayam kramaḥ om bhūḥ

original: ityayaṃ gautamoktaḥ prathamamanuṣṭheyaḥ, paścādayaṃ gautamīyavyatirekeṇātrādhikārāt | yathoktaṃ 'prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ pūtastata oṅkāramarhati |' evameva cāsmākaṃ vṛddhebhya āgamaḥ - upakrama iva sandhyopāsanasya vayamupanayanakāla eva dvividhamapi prāṇāyāmaṃ yatnenānuṣṭhāpitā vedārthaviduttamaiḥ pitṛpādaiḥ |
analyzed: iti ayam gautama uktaḥ prathamam anuṣṭheyaḥ paścāt ayam gautamīya vyatirekeṇa atra adhikārāt yathoktam prāṇāyāmaiḥ tribhiḥ pūtaḥ tatas oṅkāram arhati evam eva ca asmākam vṛddhebhyaḥ āgamaḥ upakramaḥ iva sandhyā upāsanasya vayam upanayana kāle eva dvividham api prāṇāyāmam yatnena anuṣṭhāpitāḥ veda artha vid uttamaiḥ pitṛ pādaiḥ

original: tatra vyāhṛtīnāṃ sāvitryācārtho vyākhyāto brahmarūpaḥ | lokasaptakamapi hi brahmaṇo rūpamoṃkāra sāvitrīvācyasyoktam | āpo jyotirityasyāpi sarvāṅgoparisthitatvāt prādhānyācca sākṣādbrahmaśabdavattayā śiraḥ śabdavācyasya brahmarūpamevābhidheyaṃ brahmādvaite jñānakāṇḍārthaṃ, dvaite'pi karmakāṇḍārtham | tatra brahmeti viśeṣyapadam |
analyzed: tatra vyāhṛtīnām sāvitryā ca arthaḥ vyākhyātaḥ brahma rūpaḥ loka saptakam api hi brahmaṇaḥ rūpam oṃkāra sāvitrī vācyasya uktam āpaḥ jyotiḥ iti asya api sarva aṅga upari sthita tvāt prādhānyāt ca sākṣāt brahma śabdavat tayā śiraḥ śabda vācyasya brahma rūpam eva abhidheyam brahma advaite jñāna kāṇḍa artham dvaite api karmakāṇḍa artham tatra brahma iti viśeṣya padam

original: āpa ityādīni catvāri viśeṣaṇapadāni | 'āpū vyāptau ' ityasyāpaḥ, vyāpakaḥ sarvakāryānubandhitvādato brahmaṇa eva vyāpakatvamuktam | jyotiriti jñānaprakāśakatvamuktam | rasa iti sāratvam | amṛtamiti nityānandātmakatvaṃ paramavināśitvaṃ ca | bhūrbhuvaḥ svariti lokatrayātmakatvam | asya ca śirasaḥ prabhāvo'pyuktaḥ
analyzed: āpaḥ ityādīni catvāri viśeṣaṇa padāni vyāptau iti asya apaḥ vyāpakaḥ sarva kārya anubandhi tvāt atas brahmaṇaḥ eva vyāpaka tvam uktam jyotiḥ iti jñāna prakāśaka tvam uktam rasaḥ iti sāra tvam amṛtam iti nitya ānanda ātmaka tvam parama vināśi tvam ca bhūḥ bhuvaḥ svar iti loka traya ātmaka tvam asya ca śirasaḥ prabhāvaḥ upi uktaḥ

original: ' ṣoḍaśākṣarakaṃ brahma gāyatryāstu śiraḥ smṛtam | sadāvartayanvipraḥ saṃsārādāśu mucyate ||'

original: 'gāyatryāstu śiraḥ proktamāpo jyotī raso'mṛtam | tatra prajāpaterārṣa chandohīnaṃ yajuḥ smṛtam || brahmāgnivāyu sūryāśca devatāstasya kīrtitāḥ |' iti | prāṇāyāmādanantaraṃ samantrakamācamanaṃ kuryāt | yathāha śaṅkhaḥ
analyzed: gāyatryāḥ tu śiraḥ proktam āpaḥ jyotiḥ rasa umṛtam tatra prajāpateḥ ārṣa chandaḥ hīnam yajuḥ smṛtam brahma agni vāyu sūryāḥ ca devatāḥ tasya kīrtitāḥ iti prāṇāyāmāt anantaram sa mantrakam ācamanam kuryāt yathā āha śaṅkhaḥ

original: ' evaṃ saṃmārjanaṃ kṛtvā praṇāyāmāṃśca dharmavit | upaspṛśettataḥ paścānmatreṇānena sandhyayoḥ || āpaścarasi bhūteṣu guhāyāṃ sarvamūrtiṣu |
analyzed: evam saṃmārjanam kṛtvā praṇāyāmān ca dharma vid upaspṛśet tatas paścāt matreṇa anena sandhyayoḥ āpaḥ carasi bhūteṣu guhāyām sarva mūrtiṣu

original: tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkāra āpo jyotī raso'mṛtam ||' iti | brahmocyate tadrūpā āpaḥ stotum | tvameva sarvabhūteṣu carasi | tathāhi tvamevāpaḥ | tvameva guhāyāṃ hṛdayākāśe mana ityarthaḥ | sarvendriyopalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | sarvāsu ca mūrtiṣu ye sthitā jīvātmānaste'pi tvameva | tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvameva sādhyasādhakarūpa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tvam yajñaḥ tvam vaṣaṭkāraḥ āpaḥ jyotiḥ rasa umṛtam iti brahma ucyate tad rūpāḥ āpaḥ stotum tvam eva sarva bhūteṣu carasi tathā hi tvam eva apaḥ tvam eva guhāyām hṛdaya ākāśe manaḥ iti arthaḥ sarva indriya upalakṣaṇam ca etat sarvāsu ca mūrtiṣu ye sthitāḥ jīvātmānaḥ te api tvam eva tvam yajñaḥ tvam vaṣaṭkāraḥ tvam eva sādhya sādhaka rūpaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: śanna āpo dhanvanyāḥ śannaḥ santvanūpyāḥ | śannaḥ samudriyā āpaḥ śamu naḥ santu kūpyā yā imā ityakevalābhiradbhiḥ snātāṃ yā akṛntanyā avayanyā atanvata yāśca devīrantāṃ abhito'tatantha | tāstvā devīrjarasā saṃvyayantvāyuṣmatīdaṃ paridhatsva vāsa ityahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāpyāśāsānetyantarato mauñjena dārbheṇa vā yoktreṇa sannahyati || 4 ||
analyzed: śan naḥ āpaḥ dhanvanyāḥ śan naḥ santu anūpyāḥ śan naḥ samudriyāḥ āpaḥ śamu naḥ santu kūpyāḥ yāḥ imāḥ iti a kevalābhiḥ adbhiḥ snātām yāḥ akṛntan yāḥ avayan yāḥ atanvata yāḥ ca devīḥ anta ām abhitas utatantha tāḥ tvā devīḥ jarasā saṃvyayantu āyuṣmatī idam paridhatsva vāsaḥ iti ahatam vāsaḥ paridhāpya āśāsānā iti antarataḥ mauñjena dārbheṇa vā yoktreṇa sannahyati

original: śanna āpa ityādimantreṇākevalābhiḥ savauṣadhyādigandhadravyayuktābhiḥ phalaviśeṣasahitābhiścādbhiḥ kanyāṃ strāpayet | tato 'yā akṛntan' ityādinā ahatamapūrvaparihitamatyantābhinavaṃ vastraṃ paridhāpayet | tataśca 'āśāsānā' ityādinā mantreṇāntare guptāṃ kṛtvā yathā na dṛśyate tathā vā sannahanaṃ kanyāyāḥ kuryāt mauñjena darbhanirmitena vā yokreṇa ||
analyzed: śat naḥ āpaḥ ityādi mantreṇa akevalābhiḥ sava oṣadhi ādi gandha dravya yuktābhiḥ phala viśeṣa sahitābhiḥ ca adbhiḥ kanyām strāpayet tatas yāḥ akṛntan ityādinā ahatam apūrva parihitam atyanta abhinavam vastram paridhāpayet tatas ca āśāsānāḥ ityādinā mantreṇa antare guptām kṛtvā yathā na dṛśyate tathā vā sannahanam kanyāyāḥ kuryāt mauñjena darbha nirmitena vā yokreṇa

original: śanna āpa ityanuṣṭup vyākhyātā | yā imā udāhāreṇāhṛtāḥ, tāḥ śaṃ sukhaṃ naḥ saṃtviti viśeṣaḥ ||
analyzed: śat naḥ āpaḥ iti anuṣṭubh vyākhyātā yāḥ imāḥ udāhāreṇa āhṛtāḥ tāḥ śam sukham naḥ saṃtu iti viśeṣaḥ

original: yā akṛntanniti jagatī| he āyuṣmati kanye idaṃ vāsaḥ paridhatkha paridhehi | tvāṃ ca sarvāstā devyo jarasā parivyayantu jarasā veṣṭayantu jarājarjaritāṃ sabhartṛkāṃ satīṃ tvāṃ devatāḥ sampādayantu dīrghamāyustava kurvantvityarthaḥ | kāstā devyaḥ |
analyzed: yāḥ akṛntan iti jagatī he āyuṣmati kanye idam vāsaḥ paridhatkha paridhehi tvām ca sarvāḥ tāḥ devyaḥ jarasā parivyayantu jarasā veṣṭayantu jarā jarjaritām sa bhartṛkām satīm tvām devatāḥ sampādayantu dīrgham āyuḥ tava kurvantu iti arthaḥ kāḥ tāḥ devyaḥ

original: yā idaṃ vāsokṛntan yābhiḥ kartanena saṃpāditamadhiṣṭhātrībhirdevatābhiḥ, yā avayan yābhirutaṃ saṃpāditaṃ vāsaḥ, yā atanvata yābhiḥ sūtramātataṃ dairyeṇa prasāritaṃ, yāśca devīrantāṃ abhito'tatantha, ubhayato mūlapallavasya cāntāḥ prāntāḥ yābhirātānitā ityarthaḥ | tāśca devatā mantrāntare svanāmnaivopāttāḥ 'revatīstvā vyakṣṇan' iti ||
analyzed: yāḥ idam vāsaḥ kṛntan yābhiḥ kartanena saṃpāditam adhiṣṭhātrībhiḥ devatābhiḥ yāḥ avayan saṃpāditam vāsaḥ yāḥ atanvata yābhiḥ sūtram ātatam dairyeṇa prasāritam yāḥ ca devīḥ antām ubhayatas mūla pallavasya ca antāḥ prāntāḥ yābhiḥ ātānitāḥ iti arthaḥ tāḥ ca devatāḥ mantra antare sva nāmnā eva upāttāḥ revatīḥ tvā vyakṣṇan iti

original: āśāsānā saumanasaṃ prajāṃ saubhāgyaṃ rayim | agneranuvratā bhūtvā sanna sukṛtāya kam ||
analyzed: āśāsānā saumanasam prajām saubhāgyam rayim agneḥ anuvratā bhūtvā san na sukṛtāya kam

original: anuṣṭup | pṛthivyā ārṣam | ahaṃ sanna vastraṃ badhnāmi | kimartham | sukṛtāya karmaṇe vivāhapūrvayāgadāna homādikarmārtham | kāmāyetyarthaḥ | yathā 'cakṣuṣe kaṃ pūrvamātyajyate' ityatra cakṣuṣkāmapratītiḥ, evaṃ sukṛtāya kamiti sukṛtakāmapratītiḥ | kīdṛśī satī sannaye |
analyzed: anuṣṭubh pṛthivyāḥ ārṣam aham san na vastram badhnāmi kimartham su kṛtāya karmaṇe vivāha pūrva yāga dāna homa ādi karma artham kāmāya iti arthaḥ yathā cakṣuṣe kam pūrvam ātyajyate iti atra cakṣuḥ kāma pratītiḥ evam sukṛtāya kam iti sukṛta kāma pratītiḥ kīdṛśī satī san naye

original: saumanasaṃ prasannamānasatvaṃ tathā saubhāgyaṃ bhartrānukūlyaṃ rayiṃ ca dhanamāśāsānā icchantī, tathā agneranutratā satī āhavanīyādiparicaraṇaśīlā satī sannadye || 4 ||
analyzed: saumanasam prasanna mānasa tvam tathā saubhāgyam bhartrā ānukūlyam rayim ca dhanam āśāsānā icchantī tathā agneḥ anutratā satī āhavanīya ādi paricaraṇa śīlā satī

original: preto muñcātu māmutaḥ subaddhāmamutaskarat | yatheyamiṃdra mīḍhvaḥ suputrā subhagāsati || pūṣā tveto nayatu hastagṛhyāśvinau tvā pravahatāṃ rathena | gṛhāngaccha gṛhapatnī yathāso vaśinī tvaṃ vidathe mā vadāsi || mā vidanparipaṃthino ya āsīdanti dampatī | sugebhirdurgamatītāmapadrāvantvarātaya ityudānīyoktaṃ vāsasaḥ karma || 5 ||
analyzed: pretaḥ muñcātu mā amutas su baddhām amutas karat yathā iyam iṃdra mīḍhvaḥ su putrā subhagā asati pūṣā tvā itas nayatu hasta gṛhya aśvinau tvā pravahatām rathena gṛhān gaccha gṛha patnī yathā asaḥ vaśinī tvam vidathe mā vadāsi mā vidan paripaṃthinaḥ ye āsīdanti dampatī sugebhiḥ durgam atītām apadrāvantu arātayaḥ iti udānīya uktam vāsasaḥ karma 5

original: preto muñcātvityādibhistisṛbhiḥ udānīyasthānādutkṣipya tsaṃge kṛtvā sthānāntare pitā jyeṣṭho bhrātā vā yathoktaṃ vāsasa uparibhāgācchādanasyāpyadhastanācchādanavat 'yā akṛntan' ityādinā mantreṇa karma kuryādityarthaḥ | sūryasyārṣam | prathamatṛtīye'nuṣṭubhau, dvitīyā triṣṭup | he kanye itaḥ sthānātpramuñcātu pramuñcāmi tvāṃ nayāmi bhavatīm |
analyzed: pretaḥ muñcātu ityādibhiḥ tisṛbhiḥ udānīya sthānāt utkṣipya kṛtvā sthāna antare pitā jyeṣṭhaḥ bhrātā vā yathoktam vāsasaḥ upari bhāga ācchādanasya api adhastana ācchādana vat yāḥ akṛntan ityādinā mantreṇa karma kuryāt iti arthaḥ sūryasya ārṣam prathama tṛtīyā inuṣṭubhau dvitīyā triṣṭubh he kanye itas sthānāt pramuñcātu pramuñcāmi tvām nayāmi bhavatīm

original: muñcātviti tivyatyayaḥ puruṣavyatyayaśca, tathāca śākhāntare preto mucāmīti matraḥ paṭhyate | pitṛkule bhartṛkule ca suddhāṃ suṣṭāṃ satīmetāṃ kanyāmamutaḥ pitṛkulādamutaśca bhartṛkulāt mākarat kaścinmā kārṣīt kuladvaye vigamaṃ tasyā mā kārṣīt kaścidapītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: muñcātu iti puruṣa vyatyayaḥ ca tathā ca śākhā antare pretaḥ mucāmi iti matraḥ paṭhyate pitṛ kule bhartṛ kule ca suddhām suṣṭām satīm etām kanyām amutas pitṛ kulāt amutas ca bhartṛ kulāt mā akarat kaścid mā kārṣīt kula dvaye vigamam tasyāḥ mā kārṣīt kaścid api iti arthaḥ

original: he indra parameśvara mīdaḥ sektaḥ iyaṃ kanyā suputrā subhagā ca yathā bhavati, tathā kuru | he kanye itaḥ sthānāt pūṣā indrastvāṃ nayatu | hastagṛhya hastena gṛhītvā | aśvinau ca tvāṃ rathena pravahatāmabhimataṃ sthānaṃ prāpayatām | tathā krameṇa tvaṃ gṛhānbhartṛveśmāni gaccha |
analyzed: he indra parameśvara mīdaḥ sektar iyam kanyā su putrā subhagā ca yathā bhavati tathā kuru he kanye itas sthānāt pūṣā indraḥ tvām nayatu hasta gṛhya hastena gṛhītvā aśvinau ca tvām rathena pravahatām abhimatam sthānam prāpayatām tathā krameṇa tvam gṛhān bhartṛ veśmāni gaccha

original: tatra ca gṛhapatnī gṛhasya pālayitrī prabhuryathā asaḥ bhavasi tathāstu | vaśinī jitakarmakarajanādikā bhava | vidathe ca yajñe mā vadāsi yajñapratikūlaṃ bharturmā vādīḥ vaidikakarmakalāpānukūlā bhavetyarthaḥ ||
analyzed: tatra ca gṛha patnī gṛhasya pālayitrī prabhuḥ yathā asaḥ bhavasi tathā astu vaśinī jita karmakara jana ādikā bhava vidathe ca yajñe mā vadāsi yajña pratikūlam bhartuḥ mā vādīḥ vaidika karma kalāpa anukūlā bhava iti arthaḥ

original: ye paripaṃthino mārge pratikūlācauraprabhṛtayo dampatī jāyāvarau āsīdanti duṣṭabuddhyā samāsīdanti te tvāṃ mā vidan mā drākṣuḥ sugebhiḥ śobhanagamanairdurga mārgamatītāmatikrāntāṃ sarvam |
analyzed: ye paripaṃthinaḥ mārge pratikūla a caura prabhṛtayaḥ dampatī jāyā varau āsīdanti duṣṭa buddhyā samāsīdanti te tvām mā vidan mā drākṣuḥ sugebhiḥ śobhana gamanaiḥ durga mārgam atītām atikrāntām sarvam

original: kiṃca apadvāntvarātayaḥ śatravo dānahīnāśca dhanābhāvāśca dāridyābhidhānā apadrāntu bhītāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ santaḥ palāyamānāḥ kutsitāṃ skhalanarūpāṃ gatiṃ labhantāmityarthaḥ ||
analyzed: kiṃca apadvāntva rātayaḥ śatravaḥ dāna hīnāḥ ca dhana abhāvāḥ ca dāridya abhidhānāḥ apadrāntu bhītāḥ parāṅmukhāḥ santaḥ palāyamānāḥ kutsitām skhalana rūpām gatim labhantām iti arthaḥ

original: ācārikāṇi || 6 ||
analyzed: ācārikāṇi

original: asminnavasare ācārikāṇi ācārādāgatāni deśajātikuladharmatayā prasiddhāni karmāṇi kārayedityarthaḥ | tadyathā - āgamanaprayojanakathanaṃ kanyāyā nāmagrahaṇaṃ kuladevatāpūjanaṃ sumanolatābhistāḍanamityādīni || 6 ||
analyzed: asmin avasare ācārikāṇi ācārāt āgatāni deśa jāti kula dharmatayā prasiddhāni karmāṇi kārayet iti arthaḥ tat yathā āgamana prayojana kathanam kanyāyāḥ nāma grahaṇam kula devatā pūjanam sumanaḥ latābhiḥ tāḍanam ityādīni

original: tūṣṇīṃ nirmanthyaṃ bhrāṣṭrātsāntapanaṃ yatra dīpyamānaṃ vā bahiragnimupasamādhāya parisamūhya paryukṣya pariṣicya paristīryājyaṃ vilīnotpūtaṃ kṛtvāghārādājyabhāgāntaṃ hutvāpareṇāgnimano rathaṃ vāvasthāpya yoge yoga iti yunakti dakṣiṇamitaramuttaramitarām || 7 ||
analyzed: tūṣṇīm nirmanthyam bhrāṣṭrāt sāntapanam yatra dīpyamānam vā bahis agnim upasamādhāya parisamūhya paryukṣya pariṣicya paristīrya ājyam vilīna utpūtam kṛtvā āghārāt ājyabhāga antam hutvā apareṇa agnim anaḥ ratham vā avasthāpya yoge yoge iti yunakti dakṣiṇam itaram uttaram itarām

original: 'eṣa aupasado'bhirvaivāhano vā' 'tasmin pākayajñāḥ' iti vakṣyati | vaivāha - nasya vikalpyamānāścatasraḥ prakṛtayo'trocyante | sadyaḥ araṇibhyāṃ nirmathito yastatra nirmanthyaśabdo rūḍhaḥ | tatra nirmanthana sāmānyānnirmanthanāntaravanmatre prāpte tūṣṇīmityuktam | eṣa ekaḥ | bhrāṣṭrādvitīyaḥ | sāntapanastṛtīyaḥ |
analyzed: eṣa aupasadobhiḥ vaivāhanaḥ vā tasmin pākayajñāḥ iti vakṣyati vaivāha nasya vikalpyamānāḥ catasraḥ prakṛtayaḥ utra ucyante sadyas araṇibhyām nirmathitaḥ yaḥ tatra nirmanthya śabdaḥ rūḍhaḥ tatra nirmanthana sāmānyāt nirmanthana antara vat matre prāpte tūṣṇīm iti uktam eṣaḥ ekaḥ bhrāṣṭrā dvitīyaḥ sāntapanaḥ tṛtīyaḥ

original: yo balenāgninā santaptādapasāritāgnikābhāgāt kārpāsagomayacūrṇādisaṃsargaṃ kṛtvotpādyate pāpāṇaṃ kaṃsamaṇiṃ vā tāpayitvā sūryasaṃmukhaṃ sūryakāntamaṇiṃ vā sthāpayitvā so'bhimataḥ | yatra dīpyamānaścaturthaḥ | atrāviśeṣaśrutāvapi tretāvasathaśmaśānaparigṛhītasūtakapatitādyagnivarjamiti jñeyam |
analyzed: yaḥ balena agninā santaptāt apasārita agnikā bhāgāt kārpāsa gomaya cūrṇa ādi saṃsargam kṛtvā utpādyate pāpāṇam kaṃsa maṇim vā tāpayitvā sūrya saṃmukham sūryakānta maṇim vā sthāpayitvā saḥ abhimataḥ yatra dīpyamānaḥ caturthaḥ atra aviśeṣa śrutau api tretā āvasatha śmaśāna parigṛhīta sūtaka patita ādi agni varjam iti jñeyam

original: upasamādhāyeti pratyekaṃ sambandhanīyam, gārhapatyavaduddhatāvokṣite jānudane kuṇḍe sthāpayitvetyarthaḥ | gṛhāihireveti niyamaḥ | parisamūhanaṃ sajalena kareṇa caturdiksaṃsparśanam | paryukṣaṇamāsecanam | evaṃ caturdikameva darbhaiḥ paristaraṇaṃ prathitam | prāgdakṣiṇodakṣvavastaraṇamityanye manyante tribhistaraiḥ stṛṇātīti vaiśravaṇīyadarśanāt |
analyzed: upasamādhāya iti pratyekam sambandhanīyam gārhapatya vat uddhata avokṣite kuṇḍe sthāpayitvā iti arthaḥ eva iti niyamaḥ parisamūhanam sa jalena kareṇa catur diś saṃsparśanam paryukṣaṇam āsecanam evam catur dikam eva darbhaiḥ paristaraṇam prathitam prāc dakṣiṇa udakṣu avastaraṇam iti anye manyante tribhiḥ taraiḥ stṛṇāti iti vaiśravaṇīya darśanāt

original: ājyasya vilayanaṃ vigalanam, utpavanaṃ pavitreṇa pāvanam | ādhārādājyabhāgāntān homān hutvā agneḥ paścimabhāge sthitayoḥ satoḥ kanyāvarayoryathāsaṃkhyaṃ vāmadakṣiṇabhāgenāgneraparabhāge anaḥ śakaṭaṃ, rathaṃ syandanaṃ vā sayugamavasthāpya yoge yoga ityādikayarcā kanyāvarau yūpe yunakti dakṣiṇabhāge varamuttarabhāge kanyāṃ yokreṇa
analyzed: ājyasya vilayanam vigalanam utpavanam pavitreṇa pāvanam ādhārāt ājyabhāga antān homān hutvā agneḥ paścima bhāge sthitayoḥ satoḥ kanyā varayoḥ yathāsaṃkhyam vāma dakṣiṇa bhāgena agneḥ apara bhāge anaḥ śakaṭam ratham syandanam vā sayugam avasthāpya yoge yoge iti ādikayā ṛcā kanyā varau yūpe yunakti dakṣiṇa bhāge varam uttara bhāge kanyām yokreṇa

original: saṃyojayatītyarthaḥ || yoge yoge tavastaraṃ vāje vāje havāmahe | sakhāya indramūtaye ||
analyzed: saṃyojayati iti arthaḥ yoge yoge tavastaram vāje vāje havāmahe sakhāyaḥ indram ūtaye

original: gāyatrī | maitrī | kaśyapasyārṣam | vayamindraṃ havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ | kutra | yoge yoge, dampatyoḥ sahabhāvenāvasthitayoḥ parikarmasambandhe | tathā vāje vāje, vājaśabdo'nnabalasaṃgamavacanaḥ, iha tvannavacano gṛhyate gārhasthyasyānnamūlatvāt, vājaśabdena cānnasādhanaṃ vakṣyate, haviṣi haviṣi cājyeṣṭabhāgadānāyeti protsāhanā | kimarthamāhvayāmaḥ |
analyzed: gāyatrī maitrī kaśyapasya ārṣam vayam indram havāmahe āhvayāmaḥ kutra yoge yoge dampatyoḥ sahabhāvena avasthitayoḥ parikarma sambandhe tathā vāje vāje vāja śabda unna bala saṃgama vacanaḥ iha tu anna vacanaḥ gṛhyate gārhasthyasya anna mūla tvāt vāja śabdena ca anna sādhanam vakṣyate haviṣi haviṣi ca a jyeṣṭa bhāga dānāya iti protsāhanā kimartham āhvayāmaḥ

original: ūtaye avanāya | kīdṛśā vayam | sakhāyaḥ samānakhyānāḥ | kīdṛśamindram | tavastaraṃ tavaḥ śabdo balavacanaḥ mahattvavacano vā, balavattaraṃ mahattaraṃ vā || 7||
analyzed: ūtaye avanāya kīdṛśāḥ vayam sakhāyaḥ samāna khyānāḥ kīdṛśam indram tavastaram tavaḥ śabdaḥ bala vacanaḥ mahattva vacanaḥ vā balavattaram mahattaram vā

original: tūṣṇīṃ vimucya khe rathasya khe'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato | apālāmindrastriṣpūtvā karotu sūryavarcasamiti hiraṇyaṃ niṣṭarkyaṃ baddhvādhyadhi mūrdhani dakṣiṇasminyugatarmaṇyadbhiravakṣārayate śaṃ te hiraṇyaṃ śamu santvāpaḥ śaṃ te methī bhavatu śaṃ yugasya tarma | śaṃ ta āpaḥ śatapavitrā bhavantvenā patyā tanvā saṃsṛjasveti || 8 ||

analyzed: madhyam tat chandasaḥ āhuḥ yatra adadhuḥ nāma parā iti devāḥ aruṇa piśaṅga uśvā usya dakṣiṇā yaḥ tat veda saḥ iha āgantum arhati chandasaḥ iti vyatyayena ekavacanam chandasām devānām asurāṇām ca tat anuṣṭubh chandaḥ madhyam madhya varti devāḥ ṛtvijaḥ āhuḥ vadanti

original: yatra cchandasi pareti parāgacchati devāsuracchandasāṃ madhyamanusarati anuṣṭubityanarthakaṃ nāma devā ādadhuḥ vihitavantaḥ | atrāntarā madhye'nuṣṭup vyavasthitā | tāni ṣoḍaśini grahe viniyuktāni | tatra ca ṣoḍaśini grahe aruṇapiśaṅgo'śvo'sya dakṣiṇā matā |

original: sā cetaracchandomadhye vyavasthitasya rājaprakhyasyāsyaiva cchandaso'nuṣṭublakṣaṇasya bhavatīti sambhāvyate| ata evaṃbhūtaṃ tadanuṣṭupchando yo veda vetti, sa iha pāṇigrahaṇasthāne āgantumarhati ṛtvigjanyaprabhṛtiḥ, nātadvit | devāsuracchandasāṃ tu madhyavartitvamanuṣṭubha itthaṃ 'gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭubho bṛhatīpaṃktitriṣṭubhaḥ |

original: jagatī ceti vijñeyāśchandasāṃ sapta jātayaḥ || tatraikaikākṣaravṛcyā daivānyekākṣarādīni saptākṣarāntāni sapta cchandāṃsi bhavanti | devī ekākṣarā gāyatrī | yakṣarā uṣṇik | tryakṣarānuṣṭup | evamādikrameṇa daivī jagatī satākṣarā, āsurī tu paṃcadaśākṣarā | ekaikākṣarahānyā ca prātilomyenānyānyāsurāṇi cchandāṃsi bhavanti |
analyzed: jagatī ca iti vijñeyāḥ chandasām sapta jātayaḥ tatra ekaika akṣara vṛcyāḥ daivāni eka akṣara ādīni sapta akṣara antāni sapta chandāṃsi bhavanti devī eka akṣarā gāyatrī yakṣarā uṣṇih tri akṣarā anuṣṭubh evamādi krameṇa daivī jagatī sata akṣarā āsurī tu paṃcadaśa akṣarā ekaika akṣara hānyā ca prātilomyena anyāni āsurāṇi chandāṃsi bhavanti

original: tatra navākṣarā gāyatrī bhavati | evaṃ caikākṣarādārabhya saptamākṣaraparyantānyānulomyena daivāni cchandāṃsi sthitāni | paṃcadaśākṣarādārabhya prātilomyena navamamakṣaraṃ yāvadāsurāṇi | aṣṭamaṃ tvakṣaraṃ vargadvayasya madhye bhavati | teneyamaṣṭākṣarā anuṣṭup madhye bhavatītyalamativaitatye || 17 ||
analyzed: tatra nava akṣarā gāyatrī bhavati evam ca eka akṣarāt ārabhya saptama akṣara paryantāni ānulomyena daivāni chandāṃsi sthitāni paṃcadaśa akṣarāt ārabhya prātilomyena navamam akṣaram yāvat āsurāṇi aṣṭamam tu akṣaram varga dvayasya madhye bhavati tena iyam aṣṭa akṣarā anuṣṭubh madhye bhavati iti alam ati vaitatye 17

original: yā sā upari parvata ātmanā ramamāṇeva | kṣaumamṛdvī ha vā asi tvota ojasa śṛṇomi || 21 || yā upari parvate girau meghe vā vidyudrūpeṇa madhyamavāgrūpeṇa vā ātmanā khena rūpeṇa ramamāṇeva krīḍantīva tiṣṭhati sarakhatī, sā he vadhu asi bhavasi tvaṃ nāsti naḥ saṃśayaḥ | kīdṛśī | kṣaumamṛī dukūlavatkomalā jalavṛṣṭidānenārthābhidhānena vā |
analyzed: yā sā upari parvate ātmanā ramamāṇā iva kṣauma mṛdvī ha vai asi tvotaḥ ojasaḥ śṛṇomi yā upari parvate girau meghe vā vidyut rūpeṇa madhyama vāc rūpeṇa vā ātmanā khena rūpeṇa ramamāṇā iva krīḍantī iva tiṣṭhati sarakhatī sā he vadhu asi bhavasi tvam na asti naḥ saṃśayaḥ kīdṛśī kṣauma mṛī dukūla vat komalā jala vṛṣṭi dānena artha abhidhānena vā

original: ha vai iti nipātau pādapūraṇau | evaṃ ca sati vadhūṃ vadati varaḥyatastvaṃ sarakhatī, tena tvayā ūto rakṣitaḥ sannahamojasi sati śṛṇomi ākarṇayāmi sakalaṃ kartavyaṃ śrutismṛtivihitaṃ kartavyatayā vyavasyāmi sahadharmacāriṇyāstava lābhabalenetyarthaḥ | kecittu śṛṇotviti paṭhanti | tatrāpyayaṃ madātmā śṛṇotvityarthaḥ || 21 ||

analyzed: karma śabdaḥ prayoga vacanaḥ tatram itikartavyatā vidhi antā sakṛt anuṣṭhīyamānā itikartavyatā upakāra pakṣe uttareṇa agnim pratyetya pradakṣiṇam a kṛtvā eva uttara bhāgena eva katipaya kramān gatvā pratyāgatya tatas vivāhaḥ vivāha aṅgatayā vakṣyamāṇānām ṛtu tithi ādīnām prayogaḥ ca udvāha upakāra uktānām vakṣyamāṇānām ca āvṛttyā anuṣṭhānam iti arthaḥ

analyzed: gurubhiḥ api sadbhiḥ yāni vyāmoha dāni caritāni anuṣṭhitāni tāni śraddhayā na anuṣṭhātavyāni yathā viśvāmitra ācarita śva jaghanya aśana caṇḍāla yājana ādīni tathā ye kecana aramat sakāśāt atiśayena jyāyāṃsaḥ bahu vidyā itva ādinā brāhmaṇāḥ āgaccheyuḥ teṣām svayā āsanena praśrayitavyam āsana dāna pāda saṃvāhanāt praśvasanam kheda apanodana apanodana apanodana apanodana apanodana apanodana apanodana apanodana apanodana apanodana apanoda

original: lakṣaṇaṃ kartavyam natu darpeṇodgrāhaṇikādikamārabdhavyamityarthaḥ, śraddhā āstikyabuddhistayaiva deyam | kadācittvaśraddhayā'pi deyaṃ lokavigarhaparihārāya | bahujaneṣu saṃghaṭiteṣu gā. yanādiviṣayeṣu samudāyadāne prastute karmaṇyaprasiddhiparihārāyā'śraddhayāpi deyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: lakṣaṇam kartavyam na tu darpeṇa udgrāhaṇikā ādikam ārabdhavyam iti arthaḥ śraddhā āstikya buddhiḥ tayā eva deyam kadācid tu aśraddhayā api deyam loka vigarha parihārāya bahu janeṣu saṃghaṭiteṣu gāḥ yana ādi viṣayeṣu samudāya dāne prastute karmaṇi aprasiddhi parihārāya aśraddhayā api deyam iti arthaḥ

original: 1. bahu vittvādinā .
analyzed: bahu vittu ādinā

original: athavā'śraddhayā'deyamityakārapraśleṣaḥ | saṃvit bhṛtyādibharaṇāya pratijñā - idaṃ mayā deyamiti | tayā deyamityarthaḥ | asaṃvidāpyapratijñātamapi karmakauśalamavalokya deyam | daurgatye'pi saṃbandhibāndhavārthijanāyābhyāgatāya vākbhūmitṛṇodakādi yathāśakti hiyā deyam |
analyzed: athavā aśraddhayā ādeyam iti akāra praśleṣaḥ saṃvid bhṛtya ādi bharaṇāya pratijñā idam mayā deyam iti tayā deyam iti arthaḥ asaṃvidā api apratijñātam api karma kauśalam avalokya deyam daurgatye api saṃbandhi bāndhava arthi janāya abhyāgatāya vāc bhūmi tṛṇa udaka ādi yathāśakti hiyā deyam

original: nāgavināyaka durgādyugradevatābhyaḥ pūrvatarasaṃkalpitaṃ balyupahārādi tadākramaṇabhiyā deyam | vittaṃ prayojanaṃ yatrāsti sā vittistadarthaṃ deyam | avittyai ca deyaṃ kadācit | bhūtyai vibhavāya deyabhūtyai api kadācit | śraddhayā deyamityasyaiva sarvo'nuvādaḥ stutyarthatvena vā |
analyzed: nāga vināyaka durga ādi ugra devatābhyaḥ pūrvatara saṃkalpitam bali upahāra ādi tad ākramaṇa bhiyā deyam vittam prayojanam yatra asti sā vittiḥ tad artham deyam avittyai ca deyam kadācid bhūtyai vibhavāya deya bhūtyai api kadācid śraddhayā deyam iti asya eva sarvaḥ unuvādaḥ stuti artha tvena vā

original: evaṃ vedārthe vartamānasya yadi kadācitkarmasu vaidikeṣu saṃśayaḥ syāt keṣucit, vṛttau vā jīvanopāyadhanārjane kimasmādādeyaṃ utaneti, tadā ye tatra tvannavāsadeśe brāhmaṇāstebhyaḥ sandeho'pasārayitavyaḥ | kīdṛśā brāhmaṇāḥ |
analyzed: evam veda arthe vartamānasya yadi kadācid karmasu vaidikeṣu saṃśayaḥ syāt keṣucid vṛttau vā jīvana upāya dhana arjane kim asmāt ādeyam uta na iti tadā ye tatra tu anna vāsa deśe brāhmaṇāḥ tebhyaḥ sandehaḥ upasārayitavyaḥ kīdṛśāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ

original: samyagvimarśakuśalāḥ, yuktāḥ avikalakaraṇāḥ, āyuktāḥ anuṣṭhānasaktāḥ alakṣāḥ akrūramatayaḥ, arūkṣā iti pāṭhe'pyayamevārthaḥ, alubdhāḥ alobhino lobhaśūnyāḥ | dharmakāmā vā syuḥ, dharmakāmā eva yadi syuḥ yathā te tatra karmavṛttyādau pravartante tathaiva tvaṃ pravartethāstata eva nirṇayaṃ kuryā ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: samyak vimarśa kuśalāḥ yuktāḥ avikala karaṇāḥ āyuktāḥ anuṣṭhāna saktāḥ alakṣāḥ akrūra matayaḥ arūkṣāḥ iti pāṭhe api ayam eva arthaḥ alubdhāḥ alobhinaḥ lobha śūnyāḥ dharma kāmāḥ vā syuḥ dharma kāmāḥ eva yadi syuḥ yathā te tatra karma vṛtti ādau pravartante tathā eva tvam pravartethāḥ tatas eva nirṇayam kuryāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: anyācāryapṛṣṭena ca yathārthopadeśinā bhavitavyamarthāt | ye tu tatra abhyākhyātā ābhimukhyena asaṃbhinna buddhayasteṣāṃ buddhisaṃbhedaṃ virodhaṃ ca mā kārṣīḥ | kiṃ tarhi | yathā te pūrvoktaguṇakā brāhmaṇāḥ pravarteran, tathā vartethāḥ saṃvṛttimattvena | abhyākhyātāḥ ābhimukhyena khyātāḥ mantriprabhṛtayaḥ |
analyzed: anya ācārya pṛṣṭena ca yathā artha upadeśinā bhavitavyam arthāt ye tu tatra abhyākhyātāḥ ābhimukhyena asaṃbhinna buddhayaḥ teṣām buddhi saṃbhedam virodham ca mā kārṣīḥ kim tarhi yathā te pūrva ukta guṇakāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ pravarteran tathā vartethāḥ saṃvṛttimat tvena abhyākhyātāḥ ābhimukhyena khyātāḥ mantri prabhṛtayaḥ

original: yadetanmadīyaṃ śāsanaṃ eṣa ādeśaḥ dhārmikasya rājāderājñā | upadeśo vaidiko hitaparyavasāyī vā viśeṣopaniṣadrahasyamityarthaḥ | pratyavāyābhāvena balena lobhena rahasyasaṃbodhanena cānuṣṭhātavyamevametadityarthaḥ || ityāraṇyatratāni saṃpūrṇāni ||
analyzed: yat etat madīyam śāsanam eṣaḥ ādeśaḥ dhārmikasya rāja ādeḥ ājñā upadeśaḥ vaidikaḥ hita paryavasāyī vā viśeṣa upaniṣad rahasyam iti arthaḥ pratyavāya abhāvena balena lobhena rahasya saṃbodhanena ca anuṣṭhātavyam evam etat iti arthaḥ iti āraṇya tratāni saṃpūrṇāni
